basic_info.description: Experience the allure of San Francisco living at its best in this two-story townhome in the Hip and popular OPERA PLAZA. This great home offers 2 bedrooms and 2 renovated bathrooms.  The main level opens into a lovely & bright living room with a fireplace and dining area. The kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar. On the main living level, the home also brings the luxury of a wonderful & huge south facing patio.  The staircase (with new, high quality Berber carpets) leads to the upper level which features 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 renovated bathrooms.  Both bedrooms feature great closet space with built in shelving.    This home has a great location being steps away from the Opera House, Symphony, City Hall, War Memorial Hall, and with Hayes Valley and Polk St. neighborhoods close by. Opera Plaza offers the security of a 24-hour, full-service concierge, earthquake insurance. Amenities include a heated swimming pool and SPA, Fitness Center, Pickleball court , community room.   on site professional management, a Books Inc bookstore and a Peets coffee this is a great place to call home. There is a movie theater in the building. Units in Opera Plaza do not have deeded parking.  Spaces are leased month to month.  Seller will credit buyer 12 months of parking
